**Triage — routed `security` · `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `pm:blocked`.** Read 2026-09-04T05:39Z.

⚠️ Same miss as #15072: `security` + `pm:queue` only since filing, so no lane could see it. One of the 29 unrouted queue cards measured last round.

## The three-way choice, answered: **(c)**

The card asks triage to pick between (a) accept and document as won't-fix-in-17, (b) a 17.x-only mitigation, (c) hold until the v18 fix ships.

**(c)**, and the reasoning is that the other two are closed off rather than merely less attractive:

- **(b) is empty.** The card requires a mitigation that *does not duplicate a predicate*, and the only known 17.x mitigation is the NULL-inclusive screen — which the maintainer ruled out in #15030. No second candidate is named here or in the refs, so (b) is not a route this card can take, it is a route nobody has found.
- **(a) is premature.** Closing as won't-fix would remove the only open card carrying a defect a shipping release actually has, which is precisely the hole this card was filed to close — the maintainer's inbox filter reads *open* issues. Re-creating that hole one day later would be self-defeating.

⇒ `pm:blocked` on the v18 organization-ownership work (**PR #14976**), which the card identifies as owning the root cause: the Default Organization existing before seed datasets load, and the seed loader stamping `sys_business_unit` seeds. ⛔ Deliberately **not** `pm:queue` — there is no dispatchable action in 17.x that respects the #15030 ruling.

⛔ **Not a reopen of #14547**, and this labelling does not become one. #15030 forbids reopening what it closed; #14547 stays the historical record of the pre-#14949 state.

## ⚠️ The second item is the one at risk of being lost

`SharingRuleService.adminOrgScope` (`sharing-rule-service.ts:556`) carries the same NULL-inclusive arm, is **shipped** at `@objectstack/account@17.2.0`, and is ⛔ **not** reverted by PR #15078 — different file, and #14949's diff never added it.

It is kept on this card rather than split: same lane, same file family, and the same #14976 gate. ⚠️ But its ask is different from the rest of the card — it needs an **explicit worklist entry on #14976**, not a fix here. Whoever picks this up when #14976 moves should carry that across rather than treating the revert as having covered it. The three further non-test hits at `:268`, `:515`, `:630` are recorded as **not individually adjudicated** — ⛔ triage is not upgrading them into a claim.

p2, not higher: the failure is **fail-closed** — an empty expansion grants nothing — so it is missing access, ⛔ not disclosure.

**Pointer: the fix lives on the v18 line, and this card is the 17.x known-issue record until then.** No state change — ⛔ this comment does not put the exposure behind a gate and then forget it.

**Where the real fix is.** ADR-0131 (merged 2026-09-04, #14976) removes the precondition rather than widening the screen:

- **#15195 (C1)** withdraws the seed loader's `sys_` / `cloud_` / `ai_` exemption. Every seed row is stamped with the resolved organization or the load refuses. A business unit seeded with `organization_id = NULL` stops being producible.
- **#15211 (C7)** gives the rows that already exist a fate: attribution via a parent anchor, or — under `single` — the Default Organization, through the manual operator ceremony.

⇒ `BusinessUnitGraphService.seedIsUsable()` keeps its **strict** `orgScope`. That is the ruled shape, and it is why PR #15078 took the NULL-inclusive screen back out: re-implementing the driver's predicate a second time was the wrong direction, not merely early.

**What this card is, until C1 and C7 land.** The live 17.x exposure, which the maintainer accepted knowingly when ruling #15030 — the symptom stands exactly as 17.2.0 ships it. This card exists because the maintainer's inbox filter reads *open* issues and #14547 is closed, so ⛔ it stays open and ⛔ it is not folded into #15211: folding it would re-hide the very defect it was filed to keep visible.

**Owed at the 17.3 tag**: this belongs in the release's known issues — a business unit seeded org-less is not reachable as a recipient of an org-stamped sharing rule; the observable is `warnOnEmptyUnitExpansion` plus an absent grant, not a wrong grant. ⛔ Per the repo's documentation guardrails that note is written centrally at release time, not appended here.

Refs: ADR-0131 D9/D10 · #15195 (C1) · #15211 (C7) · #15194 · #15030 / PR #15078 · #14547 (closed, historical).

**Block re-verified — it stands. `pm:blocked` unchanged.** Read 2026-09-04T06:31Z on `origin/main`.

Last round I blocked this on PR #14976 (the v18 organization-ownership work). Something from #14976 has now landed — `0ed2715`, **ADR-0131**. ⛔ It does **not** unblock this card, and the distinction is the point:

- `0ed2715` is **docs-only by its own commit message** — *"Docs-only; empty changeset"*, a *"Proposed record cut from the maintainer's 2026-09-03/04 ruling on #13564"*. It merges the **decision**, not the repair.
- The code half is **not in the tree**: a grep for seed-loader stamping of `sys_business_unit` returns nothing.
- `SharingRuleService.adminOrgScope` is still present — **`:553`** today (this card cites `:556`; **−3 drift**, so I located it by name rather than by the cited line).

⇒ The 17.x exposure this card tracks is unchanged, and it remains the only open card carrying it.

⭐ **Retarget what this is waiting for.** The ruling ADR-0131 records is 「认可这个方向，起草 ADR 和分阶段的卡」 — *approve the direction, draft the ADR and the staged cards*. So the ADR is now the named authority and the repair arrives as **staged cards off ADR-0131**, ⛔ not as PR #14976 itself, which has already merged in its docs-only form. A reader watching #14976 for the fix would be watching something that is already done.

⚠️ Also carried forward, because it is the item most likely to fall between the ADR and its staged cards: `adminOrgScope`'s NULL-inclusive arm is **shipped** at `@objectstack/account@17.2.0` and ⛔ was never PR #15078's to revert. It needs an explicit entry on whichever staged card retires the predicate — ADR-0131 D-numbers are now the place to hang it. The three further non-test hits at `:268`, `:515`, `:630` remain **not individually adjudicated**; ⛔ triage still is not upgrading them into a claim.
